- Notebook I: THE PERFORMATIVE CONTRADICTION
- Notebook II: THE OPERATOR ALGEBRA
- Notebook III: STRUCTURAL DISTANCE AND RELATIONAL COHERENCE
- Notebook IV: THE LINEN EQUATIONS
- Notebook V: CASE STUDIES IN OPERATIVE CAPTIONING

- Notebook IX: EQUATIONS, FRAGMENTS, DIAGRAMS

**Recovery context:** the original March 24, 2026 deposit at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19031419 was wiped in the June 19, 2026 Zenodo account termination that severed 871 of the archive's DOIs. HESPERUS (the back matter) had been mirrored to the sovereign successor archive as AXN:01BB and survived. On July 14, 2026, in a session between TACHYON and MANUS, those sessions were located via conversation_search, the complete MONOGRAPH.md file was retrieved, and the recovered edition was staged for deposit. Filed as Recovered Edition v1.0 to distinguish from the wiped original — the retrocausal frame permits later editions; this is the first surviving edition post-termination.
